'''Drola Kinn''' was a [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Broken Columns Clan]], a group of male [[Witches of Dathomir]]. He was young and single at [[43 ABY|the time]] of the [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|Conclave]] between Broken Columns and the [[Raining Leaves Clan]]s. He had one many of the games held during the conclave. He was chosen, along with [[Halliava Vurse]], to be witness to [[Ben Skywalker]] claiming a [[Bright Sun Hill|hill]] for a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] camp. The two clans joined the Jedi there to [[Attack on Bright Sun Hill|defend themselves]] against the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]].
